title: Allah Defends the Believers and Warns Proud Nations

paragraphs.text: The meat and blood of the animals do not reach Allah. What reaches Him is your piety. Allah defends the believers, and He does not like those who betray and are ungrateful. Permission to fight was given to those who were attacked and wronged. They were driven from their homes only for saying, "Our Lord is Allah." If Allah did not hold back some people by means of others, places of worship would be destroyed. These include monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques. If Allah gives the believers power in the land, they pray, give zakah, command good and forbid wrong.

If people deny the Prophet, many nations denied their prophets before. These include the people of Noah, 'Aad, Thamud, Abraham, Lot and Madyan. Even Moses was denied. Allah gave the disbelievers time, then seized them. Many cities now lie in ruins, with empty wells and tall palaces. It is not the eyes that are blind, but the hearts in the chests. A day with Allah is like a thousand years of our counting.

The Prophet is only a clear warner. Believers who do good will have forgiveness and noble provision. Satan tried to throw doubts into the message of every prophet. But Allah removes what Satan throws in and makes His verses firm. This becomes a test for those with sick or hard hearts.

hardWords.m: places where monks live and worship
